title: Configure an explicit legacy Mono launch
goal: Deliberately retain an unsupported Framework command-line application on Linux with Mono, explicit launch properties, quoted paths and a chosen working directory.

selectionNotes: Linux x64 Docker execution; SDK 10.0.402 and SDK 11 RC2 comparison. RC2 is not GA evidence.
Catalogue target 11.0 selects the SDK family; the actual consumer remains net472, not net11.0.

runtime.name: Mono
runtime.reason: Retained unsupported Linux Framework execution, not a .NET 11 runtime requirement.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: The current launch/output evaluation is SDK 11; historical comparison uses SDK 10.

frameworks: .NET Framework 4.7.2 (net472), executed by Mono on Linux
packageAssets: Mono 4.7.2-api reference assemblies from Ubuntu mono-devel 6.8.0.105+dfsg-3.6ubuntu2
prerequisites: Docker Linux x64, network for isolated setup, Mono reference assemblies or Clang/linker/zlib development inputs as appropriate.
constraints: No persistent environment changes; no public publication.
Microsoft no longer officially supports Framework applications on Linux through Mono. Prefer migration to supported .NET.
No universal Framework compatibility or Windows-to-Linux emulation; this sample targets net472 on both SDKs.
stabilityLimitations: Current evidence uses SDK 11 RC2, not GA.

sources.title: Configure an explicit legacy Mono launch

evidence.scope: Real Linux x64 compilation and focused execution; exact commands, inputs and measured toolchains in saved evidence.

humanProof.scope: Automated Linux checks cover the bounded route; macOS checks are explicitly not-tested, no Human gate substituted.
